text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, at the central plaza,
two academy staff members are talking with troubled expressions.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text: Who would throw something away in a place like that...?

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff B
text_block_list.text: I wonder if they misunderstood where to throw it away.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What's up? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, someone dumped a trash bag
near the hollow of the giant tree.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I want people to be careful,
but I don't even know who threw it away...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see~...
All right!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll go find whoever
left that trash bag behind for you!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff B
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nfufufu~. Leave this case to "Great Detective Teio-sama"♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's gather intel, gather intel!
Umm, excuse me, do you have a moment~?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Did you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uhm, did you happen to see any suspicious people around here yesterday~?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know what kind of game you're playing,
but I haven't seen it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so~?
Thank you so much for your help~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. Did you happen to see
anyone suspicious around here yesterday~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that way of talking?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is just how great detectives roll~.
I feel your pain~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you picked up on,
but I didn't see anyone suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see~.
Thank you for your cooperation~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uhh, it seems this case is quite a difficult one~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: By the way~, where is that discarded trash right now~?

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text: It's right there. ...Up we go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An academy staff member brought a large trash bag
and set it down in front of Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? This trash bag...
looks kinda familiar...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right... Yesterday, while taking out the trash,
I spotted the President...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I put it down for a second... and then went straight to the student council room...
I completely forgot about it...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I put it down for a second... and then went straight to the student council room...
I completely forgot about it...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-No, umm...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, hmm. I have no idea who the culprit is~
This case will forever remain unsolved~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like the culprit didn't mean any harm~.
I'm sure they're a good kid at heart~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll clean up this trash~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sooorryyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio dashed away at incredible speed,
holding the garbage bag.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Actually...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
I'm the culprit who left the trash behind...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I put it here yesterday intending to come right back,
but then I completely forgot about it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?
If you've reflected on it, you don't need to apologize anymore.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff B
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad to know
you didn't do it on purpose.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'll be more careful from now on...
